connector.name: BoostedTravel by boostedchat.com
connector.registryDescription: Flight search & booking for AI agents. 400+ airlines, $20-50 cheaper than OTAs.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.boostedchat.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package boostedtravel-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.boostedchat. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: BoostedTravel API key (get one free: npx boostedtravel-mcp or pip install boostedtravel && boostedtravel register)
